other_conditions: AICTE‑approved technical institution or university department with at least 10 years of existence (5 years if located in a rural area)
For aspiring institutions: more than 50% admission rate in each of the past 3 years; no prior MODROB project; maximum three proposals per institute per year, with only one proposal per department

For regular institutions: live NBA accreditation; more than 60% admission rate in each of the past 3 years; department must not have received a MODROB project in the last two years; maximum three proposals per institute per year (including earlier sanctioned but incomplete); preference given to institutions with industry involvement

For polytechnic institutions: AICTE‑approved polytechnic with at least 10 years of existence (5 years if located in a rural area); more than 60% admission rate in each of the past 3 years; maximum three proposals per institute per year, with only one proposal per department
benefits_summary: Each approved project is funded up to Rs.20 lakhs for a two‑year period, with 80% of the amount released in advance and the remaining 20% reimbursed after submission of a utilization certificate.
